tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You recently ordered school supplies from an online store, but there were problems with one of the items you received. You need to contact customer support to report the issue and request a resolution. Write an email to customer support.
bullets: Describe the issues with the item you received.
Suggest a solution for the problem.
Provide feedback on your online shopping experience.
tasks.subject: Problem with Item Received
